prompts.text: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Hub /projects folder configured The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `routine:env-axhub-projects-dir` (service data, status warn) - What it says: AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR isn't set - How the fix failed: - **For you:** nothing to do by hand. Point this systems-check fix at the console's Mosses chat instead of this session. `AXF_PUBLIC_URL` is stuck the same way, so both can go there together. Details: - Shared data (pending list, build queue, orchestrator) is read from the hub…
prompts.output: The fix is committed but not pushed, and the check will keep warning until it's merged. **The cause:** the hub's projects volume is mounted at `/projects` in `axf-console`, and the code already reads from there. The installer just never sets `AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR`, so the check flags it as missing. *…
